body:
Come on, only less than 2000 people rated this, if for some reason you loved it and think it deserves more you are not wrong.

The movie is very Japanese, in the west teenage love is more intense and kids are already doing more than this in their 13s. But understanding how Japanese people are and how they see life and memories as key to their personal growth is esencial for this kind of movies.

The movie is very cute and it is just a little summer story, it won't change your life or it might, it depends on how you see it.

Words bubble like a soda pop was a decent watch with okay storyline (although it could have been better). The colours were vibrant, although I didn't liked the animation much. Nonetheless, the story was a slow build romance but the emotional content and connection felt a bit lacking among the leads.

There was a story but it didn't dug deep and refused to elaborate to a 100% satisfying ending. The best part was the OST which felt quite unique and stayed well with the movie scenes. Atleast it wasn't like Uchia Hanabi, which was a total dud/disappoinment for me.

PROS: Simple yet attractive storyline The lead characters were good The OST of the anime was captivating

CONS: Didn't hate, but not liked the animation very much Story coulld have been more elaborative

My Rating : 6/10.

A charming tale of finding courage among fear and insecurity.

This is a character driven story.

It's about personal growth, and the challenges to get there. So, don't expect an intricate plot with twists and turns.

It's simple, like apple pie. And I love me some apple pie.

There are examples of masterclass level animation, from an exciting chase scene to the way someone puts on a facemask.

This is a movie I would happily add to my collection.

You have to give were the credit should be given, this movie was gorgeous looking, absolutely phenomenal artstyle, every single frame of this movie could be a wallpaper for you're computer. Next positive is our main characters yeah both are pretty generic at start but I don't know how to describe it but it was just cute for a two polar opposites to fall in love. But as usual with these kind of seasonal anime film its lacking impact in terms of both story and characters, I watched the movie about 6hrs ago and I only remember the name of cherry and smile, and the story forgettable but very wholesome. Best positive of this anime is that you can recommend this to anybody and they will all love.

I found this really adorable with cute characters that I really wanted to get together, and it had me crying at the end because of how adorable and sudden it was.

I loved the uses of haiku's to express how they are feeling or what they know, and all of this is put together in pretty and colorful animation that makes it a good enviroment for the characters.

Also the music sounds nice and fits the pretty animated scenes through out the movie.
